name: supply-test-kits
narrative: Hauwa runs procurement for a chlorine programme, and she has to buy test kits to a specification she did not write. Hauwa opens the test kit and types in the requirement Aqualytic, the technical partner, cares most about: the kit must still read at the 2 mg/L dispenser dose. Harmattan Health Supplies, the distributor, has quoted two kits with the same fifty reagent tablets and comparator, and Hauwa lines them up side by side, per test and per kit, with the cheaper Brightwell kit ranked first under a red specification badge. Before she trusts the price she reads the specification check, which names the Brightwell kit and the one requirement it fails: its range stops at 1.5 mg/L. Hauwa awards the Lumen kit that meets all three, writing down why, and asks Aqualytic to confirm it. Hauwa goes to place the order and cannot: it waits on Aqualytic's answer. Hauwa sends Aqualytic a private link to that one question. Kemi at Aqualytic opens it with no labs login and approves the Lumen kit in her own words. Hauwa sees Aqualytic's answer on the award, marked as given through Aqualytic's own link, and places the order on the terms Harmattan quoted. Hauwa records Harmattan's invoice and the bank transfer, which sits marked as not yet confirmed by the payee, and issues Harmattan a private link to this one order and its Kano warehouse. Ibrahim at Harmattan opens the link, confirms the order, and confirms the money arrived. When the kits reach the warehouse Ibrahim records twenty kits received. Hauwa opens the stock and reads the warehouse's balance in kits and in the tests they hold.

features.verify: pytest: posting requirements-TOTAL_FORMS with a range_max_mg_per_l row saves it on Commodity.spec_requirements

features.description: The product page lists each requirement with its reason in words and the rule after it.
features.verify: Playwright: the product page shows 'Must still read at the 2 mg/L dispenser dose'

features.description: round_compare puts two kit quotes in one comparable group only when their components match.
features.verify: pytest: round_compare returns both quotes in "comparable" with identical composition

features.description: Each comparison row names the trade item offered, so one supplier's two offers are told apart.
features.verify: pytest: round_compare rows carry item_name "Lumen FC-50 free chlorine kit" and "Brightwell PoolCheck-50 kit"

features.description: Each comparison row shows the offer's specification outcome and the failing requirement message.
features.verify: Playwright: the comparison shows "range_max_mg_per_l 1.5 mg/L fails" under the Brightwell row

scenes.narrative: Hauwa lines up Harmattan's two kits — the same fifty reagent tablets and comparator in each — and compares them per test and per kit, with the cheaper Brightwell kit ranked first and a red specification badge under it.

features.description: checks_list emits item_fails_specification for an item whose stated attribute fails a requirement, with the verdict and the stated values.
